description: Find GoVisit places by name or by what the traveler wants to do. Use it to identify a specific place or build a shortlist within the requested geography. Returns matching places with profile links, the search scope, and any coverage limits.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code. Supply it when the country is known to narrow the search. Intersects destination and proximity where the public geography projection is available.

destination.description: Stable destination code or all. Defaults to the current destination, otherwise all.

language.description: Requested response language; defaults to the page language.

limit.description: Maximum number of places to return. Defaults to 10. Name mode allows up to 10. Other modes allow up to 20.

mode.description: Name lookup, intent retrieval, or name-first auto discovery.

near.description: Proximity filter with a radius in meters. Supply either a GoVisit place ID or explicit coordinates as the reference.

coordinates.description: Reference point in latitude and longitude.

placeId.description: Reference GERS Place resolved from the same public release.

radiusMeters.description: Maximum straight-line distance from the reference point, in meters.

query.description: Place or destination name, or the traveler's intent.

name: search_places

coverage.description: Bounded candidate observation, not exhaustive market coverage.

address.description: Street address, for example "Pobřežní 311/1"; null when the place has none.

categoryCode.description: Published canonical category, not an amenity or suitability verdict.

coordinates.description: The place's point (WGS 84); null when it has none.

destinationCodes.description: Canonical membership; null is unestablished and an empty array is known empty.

distanceMeters.description: Straight-line geographic distance from the explicit proximity reference, not travel time.

operatingStatus.description: Published lifecycle status, not open-now or booking availability.

profileQuality.description: Published profile completeness signal; not guest fit.

score.description: Engine-specific ranking signal; compare only within the same match method, not a suitability probability.

near.description: Resolved proximity constraint; never interpreted as travel time.

title: Search places
